defs.def: a set of instructions that tells you how to cook sth and the ingredients (= items of food) you need for it 烹饪法；食谱

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国以平庸的烹饪闻名，但它正在培养出更多一流厨师，他们频繁出现在电视屏幕上，其食谱书也经常登上畅销榜榜首。

ex.s: If you enjoy cooking, for example, you may faithfully follow a recipe without questioning the instructions.
ex.t: 例如，如果你喜欢烹饪，你可能会忠实地遵循食谱，而不质疑其中的说明。

ex.s: Strictly follow traditional recipes when cooking.
ex.t: 他们的审美能力得到提升。

ex.s: “I knew if I recorded all of my parents’ recipes, it would be a great gift that I could give my family and the next generation.” she says.
ex.t: 我知道，如果我把父母的所有食谱都记录下来，那将是一份我可以送给家人和下一代的珍贵礼物，她说。

ex.s: Yet what began as a recipe book became a kind of memoir.
ex.t: 然而，最初作为食谱书的东西变成了一本回忆录。

ex.s: “It was really an amazing way to learn not only my family’s recipes, but also my family’s story.
ex.t: 这确实是一种奇妙的方式，不仅让我学到了家人的食谱，也让我了解了家族的故事。

ex.s: Why did Ms Young want to record her parents’ recipes?(no more than 15 words)
ex.t: 杨女士为什么想记录她父母的食谱？（不超过15个词）

ex.s: Campers learn technical skills of roasting, frying and cutting, as well as some recipes that they can take home and share with their families.
ex.t: 营员们学习烘烤、煎炸和切割等技术技能，以及一些可以带回家与家人分享的食谱。

ex.s: Her final goal is to link the worlds of art and science back together: She believes that bringing the old recipes to life can help develop a kind of learning that highlights experimentation, teamwork, and problem solving.
ex.t: 她的最终目标是把艺术与科学这两个世界重新联系起来：她相信，让古老配方“活”起来，有助于发展一种强调实验、团队合作和解决问题的学习方式。

ex.s: With her dad's permission, she spent the next two years researching online and conducting trials to get a recipe that was both tasty and tooth-friendly.
ex.t: 在她父亲的允许下，她花了两年时间在网上进行研究，并进行试验，以获得一种既美味又方便牙齿的食谱。

ex.s: It is produced to a dentists' recipe.
ex.t: 它是按牙医的配方生产的。

ex.s: In Save Money: Good Food, she visits a different home each week and with the help of chef Matt Tebbutt offers top tips on how to reduce food waste, while preparing recipes for under £5 per family a day.
ex.t: 在《省钱：美味食物》中，她每周走访一户不同的家庭，并在厨师马特·特巴特的帮助下，提供减少食物浪费的顶级建议，同时准备每天每户不到5英镑的食谱。

ex.s: The team transforms the family’s long weekend of celebration with less expensive but still tasty recipes.
ex.t: 团队用价格更低但依然美味的食谱改变了这个家庭漫长的周末庆祝活动。

ex.s: Meet the producers and get some excellent recipe ideas.
ex.t: 去见见生产者，并获得一些绝佳的食谱灵感。

ex.s: So, don’t forget to pick up some chicken on your way home and try this recipe out!
ex.t: 所以，别忘了在回家的路上买些鸡肉，试试这个食谱！

ex.s: The instructions in the recipe are really (confuse) and I really need your help.
ex.t: 食谱上的说明真的很令人困惑，我真的需要你的帮助。

ex.s: Find a list of its ingredients from a recipe or a product label.
ex.t: 从食谱或产品标签上找到它的食材清单。

ex.s: I hope I can learn some Chinese food recipes from them.
ex.t: 我希望我能从他们那里学到一些中国菜的食谱。

defs.def: a method or an idea that seems likely to have a particular result 方法；秘诀；诀窍

ex.s: This is probably not an authentic Chinese recipe, however, so it cannot tell us much about the Chinese.
ex.t: 不过这可能不是一道正宗的中国菜谱，所以它不能告诉我们很多关于中国人的情况。
